headings.strategy: Expressive and large, tracking-tight, never generic sans like Inter. Use for high-impact storytelling.

body.strategy: Clean sans for body copy, moderate scales text-base to text-lg.

colors.base: Midnight Blue or Deep Emerald, no pure black.
colors.backgrounds: Never use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Use solid or highly blurred semi-transparent backgrounds.
colors.rules: Tinted grey rule applies. Contrast checks are mandatory.

visual enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) and 1px inner stroke for headers. Solid backgrounds with crisp borders for cards.
visual enhancers.textures: Grain overlays and subtle noise to avoid digital flatness.

grids.rules: Asymmetry, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Direct children only in grid containers.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: use p-8 to p-24.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content. No generic centered layouts.

motion.strategy: Micro-animations for hover/focus. Smooth state transitions.
motion.rules: Do not apply universal 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition transform and opacity.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast calculator preferred. Explicitly set text color on hover.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

hero_dark_new.description: A dramatic dark photograph of a single iconic skyscraper at night, dark moody sky. Used under a dark veil with huge white OKI INC. text.

hero_light_new.description: A bright/overcast daytime photograph of a tall tower, desaturated, centered. Used under an ivory overlay with huge black text.

media.rules: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

3d libraries.recommended: Framer Motion for 2D parallax. No heavy 3D required for basic hero replacement unless specified.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the provided image_urls for the OKI Inc. homepage hero backgrounds.
Ensure dark theme gets hero_dark_new and light theme gets hero_light_new.
Implement huge OKI INC. text matching the hero background contrast constraints.
Use .js files for React components, not .tsx files.
Apply data-testid to all actionable UI elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
Do not use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Apply 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided ones.
